name: Sristi – AI Life Optimizer
subtitle: Your private life optimizer
shortDescription: Live by design, not by default. Turn authoritative health guidance into one simple daily plan. Shows ads; remove them with a one-time purchase.
longDescription:
Sristi is your private, on-device life optimizer. It turns authoritative health and wellness guidance into one simple daily plan you can actually follow — across sleep, hydration, nutrition, movement, mind, and more.

No account. No cloud. Your plan is built and stored on your device.

### Why Sristi
Most apps either overwhelm you with raw numbers or hand you advice with no source. Sristi does the opposite: every target and key fact is backed by recognized authorities — so you know the "why," not just the "what."

### What You Get, Free
• Personalized daily plan — a clear timeline from wake-up to wind-down
• Sleep & Rest — bedtime, quality, and recovery guidance
• Hydration — a water target computed from your body, activity, and climate
• Nutrition & Meals — meals, nutrients, and timing
• Movement & Exercise — a WHO-based daily activity target
• Mental & Emotional — mood, stress, and mindfulness
• Social & Relationships — connection that supports health
• Health Monitoring — vitals, symptoms, prevention
• Environment & Light — sunlight, air, and surroundings
• Safety & Emergency — always free for everyone
• A guidance Library with sources you can open and read
• Stats that show your day, week, and month at a glance

SRISTI PLUS (one-time unlock — yours forever, no subscription)
• Focus & Productivity — deep work, energy, focus
• Financial Wellness — health within your budget
• Spiritual & Purpose — meaning, values, gratitude
• Life Transitions — travel, illness, and life phases

### Private By Design
Live by design, not by default.

### Disclaimer:
Sristi is for general information, education, and well-being only — not professional advice. It does not provide medical, mental-health, legal, financial, or other professional advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and is not a medical device. Always consult a qualified professional, and follow the laws and guidance of your own country. In an emergency, contact local emergency services.
